name: Kathy Karpan
summary: Kathleen Marie Karpan (September 1, 1942 – October 24, 2025) was an American politician who served as Secretary of State of Wyoming from 1987 to 1995, and as the director of the federal Office of Surface Mining Reclamation and Enforcement from 1997 to 2000. A member of the Democratic Party, she unsuccessfully ran for Wyoming's governor and United States senator as the Democratic nominee in 1994 and 1996, respectively. She is the most recent Democrat to serve as Wyoming Secretary of State or any other statewide office aside from Dave Freudenthal's service as governor from 2003 to 2011.
